title: 🔥 LOYAULTY TO GOD > LOYALTY TO TRENDS 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 LOYAULTY TO GOD > LOYALTY TO TRENDS 🔥
When the world changes its colors every season — stay clothed in faith that never fades.
Loyalty to God is never outdated, never cancelled, never in style because it’s beyond style.
Choose conviction over conformity. Choose light over likes. 🙏💫

🎬 “When faith defines you, no trend can sway you.”
— Romans 12:2
“Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—His good, pleasing and perfect will.”
